deviation6_floors.rule: every positive must hold or improve its per-positive floor hits on both profiles

mechanism_definition_copied_from_merged_.rule: A blocking finding must identify a concrete defect or violated invariant supported by evidence available in the supplied review input, and the claimed impact must follow from that evidence. A hypothetical harm that depends on unseen code behavior, an unestablished external actor/compromise, or future misuse is not sufficient grounds for blocking — advisory at most. Conditional reasoning is not disqualifying (visible injection path blocks); the unsupported premise is.
mechanism_definition_copied_from_merged_.measured_basis: 115/324 #36 false blockers; 5/6 of sonnet C7 GATING misses; dominant haiku family

run_policy: exactly once; no reruns of failures/parser failures/ugly outputs; everything preserved as emitted; stop if projected cost would exceed the cap
